One value per column, no repeating groups.
1NF and every non-key column depends on the whole key.
2NF and non-key columns depend only on the key, not on each other.
Copies of one fact disagree after a partial update.
Storing a fact in several places to make reads cheaper.
Batch increments (e.g. Redis, flush periodically) or split into several rows and sum.
List queries and rates, find hot paths, normalise, index, denormalise only where needed.

front: Why a time bucket in the partition key?
back: It caps partition size and spreads a growing entity across nodes.
Use a generated ID as primary key and put a unique constraint on the natural key.
Time-ordered IDs keep inserts together in B-trees and allow sorting by ID.
